$comment: Copy the `mcpServers` object into your client's config:
Claude Code     .mcp.json in the project root (or: claude mcp add crossword
Mint a key at https://crossword.texs.org -> Account -> API keys. Without one,
only get_status and list_languages work. CROSSWORD_API_BASE is optional and
only needed to point at a non-production deployment.
Quota: fill_grid and improve_fill each spend one unit of the monthly fill
allowance whether or not they succeed; generate_clues is members-only and
spends the monthly AI-clue allowance, one unit per answer. Everything else
is free beyond a per-minute rate limit.
